caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass container with a lid. The container is cylindrical with slightly tapering sides and is topped with a domed, knob-like finial on the lid. The glass body features an etched or frosted decorative motif of stylized leaves, stems, and flowers, rendered in white or light gray tones. The design wraps around the midpoint of the container, with two main stylized flowers that have pointed petals, surrounded by curling tendrils, smaller leaves, and stems. The lid’s design is simple and mostly transparent, matching the container’s material. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a detailed illustration of part of the decorative design, labeled “BACK,” showing an arrangement of curving lines and leaf-like elements. The background of the drawing is a gradient wash of beige and light tan colors, with a soft shadow under the container to suggest a surface. The drawing uses a limited color palette primarily consisting of subtle grays, whites, and glassy blue-green tints to depict the reflective properties of the glass.
title: Covered Flip
